text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Gentildonna to the infirmary 
after she got injured during training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating. If you make a fuss 
over a minor scratch like this, won't you 
be unable to do anything at all?
choice_data_list: Even so, we have to treat it just in case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I treat the injury while assessing its 
condition. Fortunately, it's nothing 
serious, but pushing too hard could risk 
making it worse.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's over, then. In that case, I'm heading 
back to training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, what is it?
choice_data_list:
It's best to err on the side of caution 
and rest here.

In that case, let's be careful so it 
doesn't happen again...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Is that your view on the matter? 
Personally, I don't feel there is any 
issue."
choice_data_list: Won't you trust my word on this?
Will you trust my words on this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't that I doubted her words. 
However, wishing for her safety, I pleaded 
with earnest eyes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Then I'll believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, please adjust the regimen so that 
I can make up for the time I rested.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gentildonna rested to play it 
safe.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Gentildonna resumed her 
training, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like my assessment was a bit 
naive.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'm wrapping up training. Training that 
doesn't push me to my limits is something 
I simply cannot stand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Gentildonna's injury has gotten 
worse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Gentildonna resumed her 
training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. Looking good.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep going like this. Sitting quietly 
just isn't in my nature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna continued to exercise her body 
as much as she reasonably could.
